MDS Client Experience & Results Survey — World-Class v2 (FINAL)
Human-readable questionnaire + on-screen microcopy (Core + Deep-Dive)
Version: 2.0 • Language: English • Use case: Landing-page survey for MDS clients (modular + conditional).

1) Experience Principles (what makes this ‘world-class’)
•	Smart & relevant: clients only see questions for the modules they actually received.
•	Adaptive length: Core stays fast. If 4+ modules are selected, Core becomes ‘Prioritized Core’ (Top 2 modules in full; others as a quick mini-block).
•	Actionable by design: any low score (1–2) triggers two required recovery prompts (what happened + fastest fix).
•	Clean analytics: ‘Not Delivered Yet / In Progress’ is tracked separately from ‘Not Applicable’ to avoid inflating averages.
2) Global scale + answer options
Use the same 1–5 labels across all rating questions:
•	1 = Strongly disagree / Very dissatisfied
•	2 = Disagree / Dissatisfied
•	3 = Neutral / Mixed
•	4 = Agree / Satisfied
•	5 = Strongly agree / Very satisfied
Where relevant (execution/implementation items only), add two additional answer states:
•	Not Delivered Yet / In Progress (this should be part of scope, but hasn’t been delivered or implemented yet)
•	Not Applicable (truly not relevant to your situation)
3) Welcome screen copy (landing page header inside survey)
Headline: Help us improve your results — fast.
Body: This survey helps MDS leadership understand what’s working, what’s slowing you down, and what will create the biggest outcome in the next 90 days.
Time promise (adaptive):
•	Core: ~8–10 minutes for most clients. If you received multiple modules, we’ll prioritize the most important ones to keep it fast.
•	Deep-Dive: ~15–25 minutes for diagnostic detail.
•	Confidential: reviewed by MDS leadership + Customer Success.
•	Save & return anytime: your progress is saved automatically (Saved ✓).
4) Page flow (high-level)
1.	Welcome
2.	Setup (role, tenure, market, currency, Account Manager, mode)
3.	Module selection + optional Growth System selection
4.	Conditional setup (only if relevant: organic platforms, paid spend/KPIs/platforms, AI components)
5.	Core prioritization (only if Core + 4+ modules)
6.	Onboarding micro-block (only if tenure is 0–3 or 3–6 months)
7.	Executive Summary (always)
8.	Trust, Safety & Medical Credibility (conditional)
9.	Program-Level Experience (only if a Growth System is selected)
10.	Account Manager Scorecard (always)
11.	Scope, Timelines & Change Requests (always)
12.	Module sections (full or mini-block based on mode + prioritization)
13.	Close-out + Advocacy
14.	Thank you + confirmation
5) Survey questions (client-facing)
Below is the FINAL question set, formatted by page. Open-ended questions are written as structured prompts to improve response quality.
Step 0 — Setup (Required)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
SET_ROLE	Your role	single-select (respondent_role)	Yes	
SET_TENURE	How long have you worked with MDS?	single-select (tenure)	Yes	Routes onboarding & close-out prompts.
SET_MARKETS	Primary market(s)	multi-select (primary_markets)	Yes	
SET_CURRENCY	Currency	single-select (currency)	Yes	Drives spend band lists.
SET_AM	Select your Account Manager	dropdown	Yes	Populate from CS roster.
SET_MODE	Choose mode	single-select (core/deep)	Yes	
SET_MODULES	Select the MDS modules you received	multi-select (modules)	Yes	Gates module pages.
SET_GROWTH_SYSTEMS	Which MDS Growth System(s) were you enrolled in? (Optional)	multi-select (growth_systems)	No	If any selected → show Program-Level Experience.
Step 0B — Conditional setup (logic-driven)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
ORG_PLATFORMS	Which platforms did MDS manage?	multi-select (organic_platforms)	Yes	Show if ORGANIC_SOCIAL selected.
PAID_SPEND_BAND	Monthly ad spend range	single-select (spend_bands by currency)	Yes	Show if PAID_MEDIA selected.
PAID_PRIMARY_KPI	Primary KPI	single-select (paid_primary_kpi)	Yes	Show if PAID_MEDIA selected.
PAID_PLATFORMS	Paid platforms spent on	multi-select (paid_platforms)	Yes	Show if PAID_MEDIA selected.
PAID_PLATFORM_SPEND_MAP	Spend range per selected platform	repeater (per paid platform)	Yes	Show if PAID_MEDIA selected. Each selected platform must have a spend band.
AI_COMPONENTS	Which AI components did you receive?	multi-select (ai_components)	Yes	Show if AI_LAYER selected.
Step 0C — Core prioritization (auto)
If mode=Core and selected_modules_count >= 4:
•	Ask the client to pick up to 2 ‘Priority Modules’ to evaluate in full.
•	All other modules show only the Mini-Block (3 ratings + optional comment).
Step 0D — Onboarding & Kickoff (tenure-based)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
ONB_1	Kickoff made goals and success metrics clear.	rating 1–5 (+ Not Delivered Yet where appropriate)	Yes	Show if tenure in {0–3, 3–6}.
ONB_2	Roles and responsibilities were clear (MDS vs our team).	rating 1–5	Yes	Show if tenure in {0–3, 3–6}.
ONB_3	Access requirements were clear (accounts, pixels, assets, approvals).	rating 1–5	Yes	Show if tenure in {0–3, 3–6}.
ONB_4	Onboarding felt organized and confidence-building.	rating 1–5	Yes	Show if tenure in {0–3, 3–6}.
ONB_5	What was the #1 friction in onboarding? (Give a specific example.)	open text	Yes	Show if tenure in {0–3, 3–6}.
Section 1 — Executive Summary (always)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
EXE_SAT	Overall satisfaction with MDS.	rating 1–5	Yes	
EXE_VALUE	Value relative to outcomes achieved so far.	rating 1–5	Yes	
EXE_UNDERSTAND	MDS understood our business and patient journey.	rating 1–5	Yes	
EXE_DELIVERY	Delivery cadence matched what we agreed (consistent and well-managed).	rating 1–5 (+ Not Delivered Yet)	Yes	Allow Not Delivered Yet for newer clients.
EXE_PROGRESS	Progress toward goals so far.	rating 1–5 (+ Not Delivered Yet)	Yes	
CES_1	It was easy to move work forward with MDS (request → delivery).	rating 1–5	Yes	Customer Effort Score layer.
CES_2	Approvals and revisions felt efficient (not exhausting).	rating 1–5	Yes	
CES_3	I always knew what was needed from my side (inputs, deadlines, responsibilities).	rating 1–5	Yes	
CES_4	Communication channels were clear (WhatsApp / email / meetings / tasks).	rating 1–5	Yes	
CES_5	Escalation was easy when something was urgent.	rating 1–5 (+ Not Applicable)	Yes	Allow Not Applicable if never needed.
VAL_1	Impact on patient acquisition / bookings so far is:	single-select (val_impact)	Yes	
VAL_2	Lead quality / booking quality trend is:	single-select (val_trend)	Yes	
VAL_3	Operational fit: growth matched our capacity (front desk/ops/clinicians).	rating 1–5	Yes	
NPS_1	Likelihood to recommend MDS (0–10).	rating 0–10 (NPS)	Yes	If 0–6 → recovery branch.
NPS_REASON	What is the main reason for your score? (Be specific.)	open text	Yes	
WIN_1	What was the most valuable outcome so far? (Give one concrete example.)	open text	Yes	
GAP_1	What is the single biggest bottleneck or risk right now?	open text	Yes	
Deep-Dive adds (shown only if mode=Deep-Dive):
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
DD_CONF_90	Confidence in the next 90-day plan.	rating 1–5	No	
DD_KEEP_MODULES	If you renewed today, which modules would you keep?	multi-select (modules)	No	
DD_PAUSE_REASON	If you paused today, what’s the main reason?	multi-select + open (optional)	No	Include an ‘Other’ with text.
DD_ROI_CONF	If you had to estimate ROI confidence today, it is:	rating 1–5	No	Optional / sensitive-friendly.
DD_90_OUTCOME	What outcome matters most in the next 90 days?	single-select (Bookings/Revenue/Lead quality/Retention/Brand authority/Operational efficiency/Other)	No	
Section 1B — Trust, Safety & Medical Credibility (conditional)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
SAFE_1	MDS protected medical credibility (no risky promises, no misinformation tone).	rating 1–5	Yes	Show if any of: Paid/Organic/Video/AI/Web selected.
SAFE_2	Brand tone felt premium and trustworthy for our patients.	rating 1–5	Yes	Conditional as above.
SAFE_3	We felt safe/confident approving published content.	rating 1–5	Yes	Conditional as above.
Section 2 — Program-Level Experience (Growth Systems)
Shown only if any Growth System is selected. Repeat the block per selected Growth System.
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
PG_ROADMAP	Clear roadmap and milestones.	rating 1–5	Yes	Repeat per selected system.
PG_TAILORED	The system felt tailored to our stage and priorities.	rating 1–5	Yes	
PG_CONNECT	MDS connected strategy → execution smoothly.	rating 1–5	Yes	
PG_TTV	Time-to-value felt fast (progress became visible quickly).	rating 1–5	Yes	
PG_FOCUS	The system improved decision-making and focus.	rating 1–5	Yes	
PG_IMPACT	Overall impact so far.	rating 1–5	Yes	
PG_IMPROVE	What is the #1 improvement you want inside this system?	open text	Yes	
PG_SUCCESS90	If we continued 90 more days, what result would make you say: “This is a success”?	open text	Yes	
Deep-Dive adds (repeat per selected system):
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
PGDD_ROLES	Clarity of roles and responsibilities across MDS + your team.	rating 1–5	No	
PGDD_GOV	Governance quality (reviews, cadence, escalation).	rating 1–5	No	
PGDD_INTEG	Integration quality across modules (ads ↔ content ↔ web ↔ AI ↔ tracking).	rating 1–5	No	
PGDD_RISK	Risk management (issues found early and solved fast).	rating 1–5	No	
PGDD_CONTINUE	Would you continue this system next cycle?	single-select (Yes/No) + open why	No	
Section 3 — Account Manager Scorecard (always)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
AM_RESP	Responsiveness and availability when needed.	rating 1–5	Yes	
AM_PROACTIVE	Proactive updates (we didn’t have to chase).	rating 1–5	Yes	Avoids duplication with CES ‘channels clarity’.
AM_OWN	Ownership until issues are resolved.	rating 1–5	Yes	
AM_EXPECT	Expectation setting and transparency (realistic, clear trade-offs).	rating 1–5	Yes	
AM_COORD	Cross-team coordination (right people involved at the right time).	rating 1–5	Yes	
AM_MEET	Meetings were useful and moved decisions forward.	rating 1–5	Yes	
AM_KEEP	What should your Account Manager keep doing? (Give one example.)	open text	Yes	
AM_CHANGE	What should your Account Manager change first to improve outcomes next month?	open text	Yes	
Deep-Dive adds (mode=Deep-Dive only):
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
AMDD_STRAT	Strategic thinking and business judgement.	rating 1–5	No	
AMDD_ESC	Escalation judgement (handled urgent issues appropriately).	rating 1–5	No	Trust is primarily captured by SAFE block.
AMDD_VALUE_EX	One example where your Account Manager added real value.	open text	No	
Section 4 — Scope, Timelines & Change Requests (always)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
OPS_1	Scope was clear from the start (included vs not included).	rating 1–5	Yes	
OPS_2	Timelines were realistic and transparent.	rating 1–5	Yes	
OPS_3	When priorities changed, MDS adapted smoothly.	rating 1–5	Yes

Deep-Dive adds (mode=Deep-Dive only):
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
OPS_5	Approvals and decision-making on our side were well-managed.	rating 1–5	No	
OPS_6	We had a clear single source of truth (docs/boards/files).	rating 1–5	No	
Mini-Block (used for non-prioritized modules in Core Prioritized mode)
Banner copy: You selected multiple modules. To keep this short, we’ll quick-rate some modules and go deeper on the top priorities.
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
MINI_Q	Delivery quality	rating 1–5	Yes

Module sections (templates)
Each selected module either shows the full module block (Core priority module or any Deep-Dive mode), or the Mini-Block (Core non-prioritized). Core module blocks follow the 6 ratings + 2 opens maximum.
Module: Web & Conversion
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic

PX_FIX	What should we prioritize first to increase adoption?	open text	Yes	
Final — Close-out (always)
ID	Question / Prompt	Field type	Required	Notes / Logic
CL_1	If you could change ONE thing about MDS, what would it be?	open text	Yes	
CL_2	What should we double down on?	open text	Yes	
CL_FU	Permission to follow up?	single-select (Yes/No)	Yes	If Yes → ask channel + time window.
CL_CHAN	Preferred follow-up channel	single-select (WhatsApp/Email/Call)	No	Show if CL_FU=Yes.
CL_TIME	Best time window (optional)	short text	No	Show if CL_FU=Yes.
ADV_1	If results continue, are you open to a short testimonial/case study?	single-select (Yes/No/Maybe later)	No	
ADV_2	Would you refer MDS to a peer if we addressed your #1 gap?	single-select (Yes/No/Not yet)	No	If Not yet → ask ‘what must change first?’
ADV_2A	What must change first for you to refer us?	open text	No	Show if ADV_2=Not yet.
6) Smart Recovery (low-score branching)
Trigger conditions: any rating <= 2 OR NPS <= 6.
Follow-up questions (always required):
•	REC_WHAT: What happened? (Give a specific example.)
•	REC_FIX: What would fix it fastest in the next 30 days?
Store tags with each recovery record: module_id (if applicable), question_id, account_manager_id, severity (critical if 1, low if 2).

**Defining Application Vision**

I am now focused on defining the vision for a "World-Class" React application for the MDS Client Experience & Results Survey (Version 2.0). I am focusing on the key *Experience Principles* - Smart, adaptive length, recovery triggers, and clean analytics. I am planning the *Visuals* using Tailwind CSS for a premium look and feel.


**Refining User Journey**

I'm currently refining the user journey, ensuring a professional aesthetic and responsiveness throughout the MDS survey. The flow I am envisioning includes a welcome, setup, module selection, and conditional sections for setup, prioritization, onboarding, summaries, and trust/safety checks. I am creating key components such as progress bars, sticky CTAs, and functional forms. Features like autosave, multi-step navigation, and recovery branches are planned. I'm also building out core files.


**Defining Component Architecture**

I am now focusing on the architecture for the core React components. I'm building out the multi-step flow within `Container.tsx`, handling steps for setup, prioritization, and conditional sections with recovery logic. Modules include WEB, ORG, PAID, SB, VP, VE, YT, SEO, AI, ANA, TR, and PX. I'm using React 18+, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide-react icons, and *may* incorporate Framer Motion. Logic for priority module selection is being implemented based on the mode and number of modules selected.


**Implementing Question Mechanics**

I'm now implementing the `MINI_` question mechanics. I'm prioritizing type safety with ensured ID matching, and focusing on UX with clear error messages. Auto-scrolling will happen (less aggressive, and user controlled). I've decided to go with a modern "Consulting Premium" theme, Slate/Blue/Emerald, for aesthetics. I'm sticking to named imports, standard enums, and generics. I'm also ensuring React best practices using `createRoot`, functional components, and hooks. The survey itself is the main deliverable.


**Constructing Module Prioritization**

I am now focusing on the specific selection screen logic. Based on the selected number of modules, the "Core" module will be renamed to "Prioritized Core" if four or more modules are chosen. I'm building out the necessary files for this feature, ensuring smooth integration with the existing architecture.

payload.text:
MDS Client Experience Survey — Landing Page Copy + UI/UX Spec (v2)
Copy blocks + components + interaction rules for developers & UI/UX
Purpose: a premium landing page that drives completion and produces actionable CX signals for MDS leadership.

A) Landing Page Copy (ready to paste)
Hero
Headline	Help us improve your results — fast.
Subheadline	A short, confidential survey reviewed by MDS leadership to strengthen delivery and outcomes in the next 90 days.
Primary CTA	Start survey
Secondary CTA	Save & continue later
Trust & privacy
•	Confidential: Your feedback is reviewed by MDS leadership + Customer Success.
•	Smart flow: You’ll only see questions related to the modules you received.
•	You can save and return anytime — progress is autosaved (Saved ✓).
Optional reassurance line (small text): It’s okay to answer “Not sure” — this is used to improve execution, not to judge your team.
How it works (3-step strip)
1.	Select your MDS modules (so we only ask what’s relevant).
2.	Answer the Core survey (~8–10 min for most clients) or Deep-Dive (~15–25 min).
3.	Submit — and we’ll use your feedback to improve the next cycle.
Mode explainer (Core vs Deep-Dive)
•	Core: Fast, executive-friendly. If you selected multiple modules, we’ll prioritize the most important ones to keep it short.
•	Deep-Dive: Diagnostic detail for operational improvement and faster wins.
Footer microcopy
Need help while completing the survey? Contact your Account Manager or Customer Success.
B) UI/UX Component Spec (developer-ready)
1) Page layout rules
•	Single-column layout (mobile-first).
•	Max ~6–8 questions per screen; group by theme.
•	Sticky bottom action bar: Back (left) + Continue (right).
•	Progress indicator always visible: ‘Step X of Y’ + % bar (updates after module selection).
2) Save & Continue (critical)
•	Autosave after every answer change (debounced).
•	Inline indicator near stepper: “Saved ✓” and “Saving…” states.
•	Provide an ‘Email me my resume link’ button (optional) after Setup; requires email capture.
•	Resume links must be single-use token URLs with expiry (e.g., 30–90 days).
3) Registration / Sign-in (recommended pattern)
Two acceptable options (choose based on your pipeline):
•	Option A (recommended for best completion): no full account creation; use email + one-time token link for Save/Resume.
•	Option B (enterprise / multi-stakeholder): lightweight sign-in (email + OTP) so stakeholders can return and contribute.
If using sign-in, make it OPTIONAL and postpone until the user clicks ‘Save & continue later’ (reduce drop-off).
4) Conditional logic UX
•	Show/hide follow-up questions inline (avoid page reload).
•	Use short helper text above conditional blocks: “Only shown because you selected Paid Media.”
•	For repeaters (paid spend per platform), show a compact table-like UI with platform chips + spend dropdown per chip.
5) Recovery UX (low scores)
•	If a user selects 1–2 (or NPS 0–6), immediately show a short ‘2-question’ recovery block.
•	Recovery questions are required before allowing the user to continue.
•	Copy: “Quick follow-up so we can fix this.”
6) Completion screen
•	Thank you message + ‘What happens next’ (leadership review + next cycle improvement).
•	If permission to follow up = Yes: show a button ‘Schedule a 15-min review’ (link to booking or CS workflow).
•	Show a lightweight auto-summary for the client: Top priorities captured (from their answers).
C) Email templates (short)
1) Resume link email
Subject: Your MDS survey link (resume anytime)
Body: Here’s your secure link to resume the survey where you left off: [Resume Link]. If you didn’t request this, you can ignore this email.
2) Submission confirmation
Subject: Thank you — your MDS feedback was submitted
Body: Thank you. Your feedback has been received and will be reviewed by MDS leadership. If you requested follow-up, your Account Manager will reach out via your preferred channel.
D) Implementation checklist
•	Implement adaptive Core logic (Top 2 priority modules if 4+ selected).
•	Implement two-state ‘N/A’ split: Not Delivered Yet vs Not Applicable.
•	Implement low-score recovery branching (<=2, or NPS<=6).
•	Autosave + resume token link workflow.
•	Internal notification routing for critical alerts (rating=1 or NPS 0–6).
•	Dashboard computations: Overall Experience, CES, OPS, SAFE, AM, module scores, top risks/strengths.

**Considering Landing Page Updates**

I'm currently focused on the updates to the "MDS Client Experience & Results Survey" app, specifically the landing page. I'm working with the new copy and UI/UX specs, concentrating on a single-column layout for the updated design. I'm aiming to refine the user experience to be as intuitive as possible.


**Implementing Survey Enhancements**

I'm now diving into the specifics of the MDS survey app. I'm prioritizing adding a "Save & Continue Later" button, and have simulated the "Resume link" with email capture. I'm also focused on refining the navigation and autosave indicator. I'm now developing conditional logic with a UX that's inline and the recovery UX. The completion screen requires additions, including "What happens next" and review summary sections. I'm also fleshing out the "Program-Level Experience," "Account Manager Scorecard," and "Conditional Setup" for a more complete module.


**Developing Question Logic**

I'm now deep in the weeds of defining survey logic. I'm focusing on conditional question sets based on factors like tenure, module usage (like AI, Paid, or Organizational platforms), and whether a deep dive is needed. I'm adding constants for all questions, and I'll update the app to correctly render these question sets with improved styling. The survey structure will be either full or mini based on core prioritization.


**Building Data-Driven Rendering**

I'm now shifting to a data-driven approach for the MDS app, starting with `App.tsx`. I'll update `types.ts` to include complex question types and then populate `constants.ts` with the full question set. Next, I'll update `App.tsx` to dynamically render sections and conditional logic, focusing on factors such as platform, spend bands, and the CL_FU conditional. I also plan to improve the styling to achieve a more "World-Class" feel. I will add a "Save & Return Later" modal to complete this update.

I will now update the MDS Client Experience Survey to its final, world-class v2 specification. 

### Key Updates:
1.  **Full Question Set Implementation**: I am integrating the complete, final questionnaire including Executive Summary (CES, Value, Progress), Program-Level Experience, Account Manager Scorecard, and Scope & Timelines sections.
2.  **Advanced Conditional Logic**:
    *   **Conditional Setup**: Added logic for Organic Platforms, Paid Media KPIs/Spend, and AI components.
    *   **Tenure-based Onboarding**: Automatically injects the onboarding micro-block for clients with <6 months tenure.
    *   **Trust & Safety Block**: Triggers only when high-visibility modules (Paid/Organic/Web/AI/Video) are selected.
3.  **Adaptive Length & Core Prioritization**: Fully implemented the logic where if 4+ modules are selected in Core mode, the user picks 2 priorities for full evaluation, and the rest collapse into "Mini-Blocks".
4.  **World-Class UI/UX Improvements**:
    *   **Sticky Navigation Bar**: Improved bottom bar with clear primary/secondary actions.
    *   **Save & Resume**: Added a "Save & Continue Later" feature with a simulated token/email capture.
    *   **Smart Recovery**: Interactive 2-question recovery blocks that trigger immediately upon low scores (<=2 or NPS <=6).
    *   **Responsive Repeater UI**: A custom interface for mapping spend bands to specific paid platforms.

9) Scoring formulas
•	Overall Experience Score = avg(EXE_SAT, EXE_VALUE, EXE_UNDERSTAND, EXE_DELIVERY, EXE_PROGRESS)
•	CES Score = avg(CES_1..CES_5)
•	Value/Outcome Signals are categorical; track distributions (VAL_1, VAL_2) + avg(VAL_3)
•	Trust/Safety Score = avg(SAFE_1..SAFE_3) (when shown)
